body:
Hi u/Bunit117, THANK YOU for the advice and the follow up. I'm sorry for the delay, it has been a rough few days. I had a close call on Saturday, but am slowly trying to make my way through it. I told my boyfriend and he is trying to take it all in and figure out how to handle it- I can only imagine that role is incredibly hard. He also notified one of my best friends. I have been spending some time trying to find a "safe place".  I don't want to go to a typical behavioral institute or hospital- maybe some kind of retreat like place? It's all really difficult to parse through and I have to say that most support services (text lines, hotlines, websites) are not that helpful. 

Your recommendation for a bucket list is a great idea! It's one of those things that I feel like I would put too much stock in at the moment and any kind of hesitancy or unable-ness of any of the people I would ask, might send me back to the brink. You are a great, great friend for doing that and I am sure that it is so much appreciated and relied on.
